position_geometry_mode_note: Pythonic POSITION/XYZWPR colon, INV and FRAME follow ../position-geometry.md. Older POSITION geometry exclusions below describe the preserved conservative contract; other positional types and exact routine interfaces retain their boundaries.
position_conversion_mode_note: Pythonic whole-value POSITION/XYZWPR assignments follow ../position-conversions.md; older blanket assignment/initialization exclusions below remain for the future strict milestone. Other positional types and exact routine interfaces retain their boundaries.
scope: POS fallback construction of independent checked XYZWPR values

reference_basis.documented: POS(x,y,z,w,p,r,c) returns XYZWPR; Cartesian components bounded to plus/minus 10000000 mm, orientation components to plus/minus 180 degrees; CONFIG must be valid for the robot
reference_basis.uncertainty: Robot-specific CONFIG validity, native pause/alarm behavior and release-specific runtime acceptance are unverified

implementation_choices.numbers: Finite Python float components, with integral promotion and inclusive documented bounds; no normalization or orientation conversion
implementation_choices.configuration: Require exact complete initialized CONFIG shape and checked fields, retaining prototype turns -8..7; copy without inferring robot validity
implementation_choices.order: Arguments once left to right, followed by bounds/config checks; ordinary expression failures stop later arguments; retain prior effects and destination on failure
implementation_choices.composition: Exact XYZWPR storage, aliases, record/array fields, internal results/value arguments and temporary field access; preserve copy/capture/effect/FOR protections
implementation_choices.name: Fallback without an explicit internal POS routine; preserve ordinary POS declarations and user signature/effect behavior
implementation_choices.observations: Source-located pos_constructors and current pos_policy; user routines are not constructor sites

retained_boundaries: No default CONFIG, implicit POSITION/XYZWPREXT/JOINTPOS conversion, frame/group context or kinematics
UNPOS still requires ordinary captured source storage and disjoint outputs
POSITION orientation remains protected; strict is future work; no controller validity or native runtime claim
